description: Clears the document-level generatedAt and the radarReports list so RadarReports in src/components/RadarReports/index.js takes its two empty-corpus arms: the shared MirrorSyncStatus it renders returns null through its !generatedAt guard in src/components/shared/MirrorSyncStatus.js, and RadarReports' 'data.radarReports || []' fallback supplies the list the page maps over. Both fields are document-level on the one file the one /resources/radar-reports page reads, so clearing them in the ordinary coverage build would not add a case -- it would trade the provenance line and all six rendered reports for these two arms. The variant build is served beside the real one, so one Playwright run reaches both. It does not yet move the two regions out of the e2e report's uncovered list: both builds' generated code maps the branches back to different original coordinates, which is the region-attribution problem raised in #1066 and #1079, both now closed (#1066 as not planned), so it is accepted behaviour rather than pending work. The browser taking the arms is pinned by tests/e2e/radar-reports-variant.spec.js regardless.
